faq.title: You may be <accent>wondering</accent>
faq.a1: Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube all connect to Postbiz. What Postbiz can do on each (publish, private messages, comments) varies with what the network allows: the Channels page gives the exact status, network by network.
faq.q2: Can I reply to private messages on LinkedIn or YouTube?
faq.a2: No, and no third-party tool can without a special agreement: LinkedIn does not open its messaging to apps, and YouTube has no private messages. Postbiz will show YouTube comments, and LinkedIn Page comments as soon as they are available.
faq.a3: On Messenger and Instagram, Meta lets a business reply for 24 hours after the customer’s last message. Postbiz shows the time left on every conversation so you know what to handle first.
faq.q4: Are my messages used to train an AI?
faq.a4: No. Postbiz does not use your messages or posts to train models.
faq.a5: The beta is free, no credit card needed. The price list is already public on the Pricing page, so you know what to expect.
faq.a6: Yes. Postbiz is open-source software (AGPL-3.0) built on Supabase. If you modify it and offer it to third parties, you must publish your changes.

s1.p1: Postbiz is an online service available at getpostbiz.com. It lets you schedule and publish content, manage messages and comments, and get help from an AI assistant, on the social media accounts that the user connects.
s1.p2: The service is operated by: {entity}. These terms apply to any use of the website and the app. By creating an account or connecting a social network, the user accepts them.

s2.p1: The user creates an account with a valid email address. They must be of legal age to enter into a contract, or be authorized to do so by a legal guardian, and must keep their credentials safe. They are responsible for actions taken from their account and by the members they invite to their organization.

s3.p1: Postbiz acts only on the accounts the user authorizes, through the official interfaces (APIs) of Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube. The user remains subject to the terms of each of these networks (for example, the 24-hour window to reply to messages on Messenger and Instagram) and warrants that they hold the necessary rights over the content they publish. Postbiz is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by these networks.
s3.p2: The available features depend on the permissions granted by each network, which may change or be withdrawn. Postbiz does not guarantee that a feature is available on a given network. The user can withdraw Postbiz’s access at any time, from Postbiz (Channels, then Disconnect) or from the settings of the network concerned.
s3.p3: By using the YouTube features of Postbiz, the user agrees to be bound by the <yt>YouTube Terms of Service</yt>. Content sent to TikTok is subject to the <tt>TikTok Terms of Service</tt>.

s4.p1: The user keeps all rights over the texts, images and videos they upload or publish with Postbiz. They grant Postbiz a limited, non-exclusive licence to store, process and transmit them to the networks they have chosen, for the sole purpose of providing the service.
s4.p2: The user is solely responsible for this content and for its compliance with the law and with the rules of the networks.

s5.li2: send unsolicited bulk messages or seek fake engagement;
s5.li3: distribute content that is illegal, hateful, misleading or infringes a third party’s rights;
s5.li4: access someone else’s account without their permission;
s5.li5: attempt to bypass the technical, security or quota limits of the service or of the networks.
s5.p2: Postbiz may suspend without notice an account that threatens the security of the service or of a user’s social media account.

s6.h: 6. AI assistant, knowledge base and automatic replies
s6.p1: The AI assistant proposes drafts based on the user’s instructions. Its suggestions may contain mistakes: the user reviews them before publishing and remains responsible for them. The text entered in the assistant is sent to our AI provider to produce the answer (see the privacy policy).
s6.p2: Automatic replies are configured by the user, who is responsible for them.
s6.p3: The user warrants that they hold the necessary rights over the documents and websites they add to their knowledge base, and that they only add websites whose content they are entitled to have read automatically. Postbiz reads only publicly accessible pages, identifies itself as <bot>PostbizBot</bot> and follows the rules of each site’s robots.txt file. The user remains responsible for the content they add and for the drafts they publish from it.

s7.p1: During the beta, the service is provided free of charge. The prices published on the Pricing page will apply once the beta ends, after at least 30 days’ prior notice to the user. No payment is required without the user’s explicit agreement.

s8.p1: Postbiz uses reasonable efforts to keep the service running, without guaranteeing that it will never be interrupted. A post may fail or be delayed because of a third-party network (outage, quota, content refused); Postbiz then informs the user in the app.
s8.p2: To the extent permitted by law, Postbiz is not liable for indirect damages (such as loss of audience or revenue) or for decisions taken by a social network regarding the user’s accounts. These terms do not exclude any liability that cannot be excluded by law, in particular towards consumers.

s9.p1: The user may delete their account at any time. Postbiz may suspend or close an account in case of breach of these terms or of a third-party network’s rules. Data is then deleted as described in the privacy policy.

s10.p1: The Postbiz source code is published under the GNU AGPL-3.0 licence. That licence governs the code; these terms govern the service hosted by the publisher.

s11.p1: We may change these terms, for example to reflect changes to the service or the law. For any significant change, the user is informed in the app or by email before it takes effect. Continuing to use the service means accepting the changes.

s12.p1: These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, the French courts have jurisdiction, subject to the protective rules applicable to consumers.

s1.p1: {entity}. For any question about your personal data: <mail>{email}</mail>.

s2.li1: Account: email address, display name, password (stored in hashed form by our authentication provider).
s2.li2: Connected channels: account identifier, name and picture, and the access tokens provided by the network (encrypted before storage).
s2.li3: Messages and comments: content received and sent on the accounts you connect, along with the public identifier, name and handle of the people who write to you.
s2.li4: Posts and media: texts, images and videos that you schedule or upload to the library, and their dates.
s2.li5: AI assistant: the instructions you enter in the assistant.
s2.li6: Usage: technical logs needed for the security and proper operation of the service.
s2.li7: Knowledge base: the entries you write, the documents you upload (kept privately in your workspace) and the text read from the public pages of the websites you add.
s2.li8: Payment: chosen plan, amounts, dates, country and status of your payments (card via Stripe, mobile money via PawaPay). We neither see nor keep your card number or your mobile wallet’s secret code.
s2.li9: Approximate country: to show prices in the right currency, a visitor’s country is inferred from their IP address (header provided by the host; otherwise a geolocation service queried from our servers). This country is not stored in our database: only the one you choose yourself is remembered, in a cookie.

s3.h: 3. What we receive from social networks
s3.p1: Only after you authorize it, and only what is needed for the features you use:
s3.li1: Facebook and Instagram: the Pages and professional accounts you connect (identifier, name, picture), their messages and comments, and the publishing of your content.
s3.li2: LinkedIn: your profile (identifier, name, picture) or the Pages you manage, in order to publish to them.
s3.li3: X: your profile (identifier, name, picture), in order to publish to it.
s3.li4: YouTube (Google): your channel (identifier, name, picture), in order to upload videos and manage their comments.
s3.li5: TikTok: your account’s identifier, display name and picture, in order to send the videos you choose.
s3.p2: Access tokens are encrypted before storage and deleted when you disconnect the channel.

s4.p1: Postbiz’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the <gu>Google API Services User Data Policy</gu>, including the Limited Use requirements.
s4.p2: YouTube data is used only to display the connected channel and to publish or manage the content you request. It is not sold, not used for advertising, and not shared with third parties except where necessary to provide the service, to comply with the law, or with your consent, and it is not used to train artificial intelligence models.
s4.p3: You can withdraw Postbiz’s access to your Google account at any time from your <gs>Google security permissions</gs>, or disconnect the channel in Postbiz. Google Privacy Policy: <gp>policies.google.com/privacy</gp>.

s5.p1: With TikTok Login Kit and the Content Posting API, Postbiz receives your account’s identifier, display name and picture, and sends to your account the videos you choose to publish, only at your request. This data is neither sold nor used for advertising.
s5.p2: You can withdraw access from Postbiz (Disconnect revokes the token with TikTok) or in your TikTok account settings. See also the <tp>TikTok Privacy Policy</tp>.

s6.li1: Provide the service (performance of the contract).
s6.li2: Ensure security and prevent abuse (legitimate interest).
s6.p1: We do not sell your data, we do not run advertising, and we do not use your messages or posts to train artificial intelligence models.

s7.li1: Supabase Inc. — database, authentication and file storage.
s7.li2: Vercel Inc. — hosting of the website and the app.
s7.li3: Email delivery provider — sign-in messages and notifications.
s7.li4: OpenAI — AI assistant, agent, picture generation, knowledge base search and reply suggestions, only when you use them: the text you enter, your knowledge base (the entries, and the text of the documents and websites you add, are also turned into numerical vectors when you save or add them), the messages of the conversation you ask a reply for and, for the agent, your connected channels’ names and recent posts are sent to it to produce the answer; pictures are generated from the description the agent writes.
s7.li5: Evolink (Seedance) — video generation, only when you ask the agent for a video: the description of the video and, if you choose reference pictures, temporary links to those pictures are sent to it.
s7.p1: The social networks you connect are separate data controllers, governed by their own policies. Some processors are located outside the European Union, notably in the United States: transfers then rely on the mechanisms provided for by the GDPR (adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses).
s7.li6: Stripe Payments Europe Ltd. — card payments and subscription management.
s7.li7: PawaPay — mobile money payments in supported African countries.
s7.li8: IP geolocation service — only when the host does not provide the visitor’s country; the address is neither logged nor kept by Postbiz.

s8.p1: Account data is kept as long as the account exists. A channel’s access tokens are deleted when you disconnect it; the related messages and comments are deleted within 30 days. When you delete your account, the associated data is erased within the same period.
s8.p2: Payment records (amount, date, plan, provider reference) are kept for the legal period that applies to accounting records, even after the account is deleted.

s9.p1: Postbiz only uses strictly necessary cookies and storage: the sign-in session, your language, the country you chose for prices and your display preferences. There are no advertising cookies and no third-party analytics tools.

s10.p1: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability of your data, and object to its processing, by writing to <mail>{email}</mail>. To have your data erased, see also the <del>Data deletion</del> page. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority.

s11.p1: Data is isolated per organization at the database level, access tokens are encrypted, and traffic is encrypted. As no system is infallible, we will inform you of any incident affecting your data.

s12.p1: Postbiz is intended for professionals and is not meant for people under 16.
s12.p2: We may update this policy. For any significant change, you will be informed in the app or by email.

s1.p: In Postbiz, open Channels, choose the channel, then Disconnect. Access tokens are deleted immediately, and the related conversations and messages within 30 days.

s2.p: In Settings, choose Delete my account. Your profile, the organizations of which you are the only administrator and all associated data are deleted within 30 days.

s3.h: You removed Postbiz from Facebook or Instagram
s3.p: If you remove the Postbiz app from your Facebook or Instagram account settings, we stop receiving your data and delete the matching tokens. To ask for the erasure of conversations already stored, write to us with the name of the account concerned.

s4.p: Write to <mail>{email}</mail> from your account’s address. We confirm the deletion by reply.

s1.p: PostbizBot is the robot Postbiz uses to read the public pages of the websites that its customers add to their knowledge base, so that the AI assistant can rely on them to write posts and replies for that customer. It reads a site only because a customer asked for it: it does not browse or index the web. What it reads is used only for that customer, and is neither sold nor published.

s2.li1: It identifies itself with the user agent PostbizBot/1.0, followed by the address of this page.
s2.li2: It reads only public pages, never behind a login, and stays on the site it was asked to read: up to 50 pages per site, found through the sitemap and the links of the pages.
s2.li3: It reads the robots.txt file of the site first and follows it, including the Crawl-delay directive (up to 10 seconds); otherwise it waits at least 0.7 second between two requests.
s2.li4: It does not run JavaScript, does not submit forms and does not accept cookies.
s2.li5: It reads a site again on its own at most once a week; its customer can also ask for a new reading, at most once every 10 minutes. Pages that have not changed are not stored again.

s3.p2: To block only part of the site, replace / with the path to exclude. For any question, or if PostbizBot causes you a problem, write to {email}.

channelsPage.intro: Each network decides what third-party tools are allowed to do. Rather than promise a “universal” inbox, here is the real status, network by network.

why1.title: Why not all messages?
why1.text: LinkedIn and YouTube do not give third-party apps access to private messages. We do not work around these rules: it would put your accounts at risk.

why2.title: Why this 24-hour window?
why2.text: It is a Meta rule for Messenger and Instagram. Postbiz shows the time left for each conversation.

why3.title: Missing a network?

productInbox.title: All your messages and comments, <accent>in a single list</accent>
productInbox.intro: No more jumping from one app to another. Messenger, Instagram and the comments on your posts arrive live in Postbiz, with the context to reply fast and well.

p1.title: Live
p1.text: New messages appear without reloading the page, on the web and on mobile.

p2.title: The 24-hour window, visible
p2.text: Each Messenger or Instagram conversation shows the time left to reply, and the most urgent ones come first.

p3.title: Built for teams

p4.title: Drafts and clear states

p6.title: Guided reconnection

channelsPage.intro: The social media accounts connected to your organization.
channelsPage.proAccountRequired: A professional Instagram account (Business or Creator) is required: it's free and set in Instagram's settings. A personal account can't be connected.
channelsPage.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect “{name}”? The tokens will be deleted and pending posts on this channel will fail.
channelsPage.demoWarn: Demo mode: connecting accounts requires a configured Supabase project.
channelsPage.configWarn: Connecting accounts becomes available once each network’s API keys are configured (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, X apps).
channelsPage.seeDocs: See docs/RESEAUX.md in the repository for the steps.
channelsPage.adminOnly: Only an organization administrator can connect a channel.
channelsPage.flashWebhooks: Warning: subscribing to the Page’s messages failed, you will not receive its messages in the inbox until it is redone (reconnect the channel).
channelsPage.flashDisconnected: Channel disconnected: the tokens have been deleted.
channelsPage.flashCleanupFailed: Channel disconnected and tokens deleted here. Revoking access at the network failed: remove Postbiz from the authorized apps of your account.

onboarding.label: Getting started with Postbiz
onboarding.quitText: You can connect your channels later from the Channels page.
onboarding.channelsSubtitle: Connect your social media accounts to start scheduling posts and replying to your messages.
onboarding.clickToAdd: Click a channel to add it
onboarding.hintDemo: Demo mode: the connection is simulated.
onboarding.hintAdminOnly: Only an organization administrator can connect a channel.
onboarding.hintUnavailable: Connection unavailable: this network’s API keys are not configured on this server yet (see docs/RESEAUX.md).
onboarding.agentsSubtitle: Let the agent of your choice create and schedule posts for you.
onboarding.agentsSoon: This step will be enabled soon: the Postbiz MCP server, CLI and public API are not available yet. You can skip it.
onboarding.mcpText: Give your agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor…) tools to create, schedule and manage your posts.
onboarding.cliText: Install the Postbiz CLI and let your agent use it from your terminal.
onboarding.apiText: Drive Postbiz from your own tools (n8n, Make, scripts).
onboarding.tutorialVideo: Watch this short video to get the most out of Postbiz.
onboarding.tutorialSteps: Three steps are enough to get started.

check1.title: Connect a channel
check1.text: From the Channels page: your Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok or YouTube accounts.

check2.title: Schedule a post
check2.text: In the calendar, click a free slot, write, choose the channels.

check3.title: Reply to your messages
check3.text: Private messages and comments arrive live in the inbox.

errors.generic: The operation failed. Please try again in a moment.

knowledgePage.intro: What the AI knows about your business: brand tone, offers, products, frequently asked questions. It uses it to write your posts (AI assistant and agent) and to suggest replies in the inbox.
knowledgePage.privacy: Entries, documents and websites are stored in your Postbiz workspace. When the AI needs them, the relevant passages are sent to OpenAI with the request: do not put customers’ personal data in them.
knowledgePage.demoNote: Demo mode: the search works on words and no AI is called.
knowledgePage.noEmbeddings: Search by meaning is not active on this server (OPENAI_API_KEY is missing): the AI only searches by words.
knowledgePage.overBudget: The pinned entries are over the budget: the oldest ones are no longer sent in full, the AI looks them up when needed.
knowledgePage.empty: No entries yet. Start with your brand tone, your offers and your frequently asked questions.

pin.switch: Always send the entry “{title}” to the AI
pin.hint: A pinned entry is sent in full with every request (brand tone, rules). Otherwise the AI only looks it up when the question is about it.

test.title: Test a question
test.hint: Ask a question the way a customer would: you see the passages the AI would find.
test.placeholder: E.g. Are you open on Sundays?
test.hybrid: Search by meaning and by words
test.none: Nothing relevant found in the knowledge base: the AI could not answer from it.

errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow testing the knowledge base.
errors.rate_limited: Too many searches in a row. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.failed: The search failed. Try again in a moment.

docs.hint: PDF (with selectable text), Word, text, Markdown, CSV or HTML files, up to {max} MB each. The AI looks them up when a question is about them.
docs.empty: No documents yet. Add your catalog, your terms of sale or a price list.
docs.demoNote: Demo mode: the file is read right away on this server, with no storage and no AI.

sites.hint: Postbiz reads the public pages of the site (up to {max}), follows its robots.txt, and reads it again every week. Only add sites whose content you have the right to use.
sites.autoSync: Read the site again every week
sites.demoNote: Demo mode: no page is read on the Internet, a sample site stands in for yours.

sources.syncFailed: The last update failed, the previous content is kept: {reason}
sources.stalled: Still waiting: documents and websites are read by the Postbiz worker, which must be running.

warnings.truncated: Only the beginning is kept: the limit of pages or passages for one source was reached.
warnings.timeLimit: The reading stopped at the time limit: the rest will be read at the next refresh.
warnings.spa: Pages that only show their content with JavaScript were not read: {count}
warnings.robots: Pages skipped because the site asks robots not to read them (robots.txt): {count}
warnings.failed: Pages that could not be read: {count}

errors.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported (PDF, Word, text, Markdown, CSV or HTML).
errors.file_missing: The file was not found in storage: send it again.
errors.corrupt: The file is damaged, or is not what its name says.
errors.encrypted: The file is protected by a password: remove the protection and send it again.
errors.no_text: No text to read. A PDF made of scanned images cannot be read: it would need text recognition.
errors.blocked_address: This address is not publicly reachable.
errors.dns_failed: The domain name could not be found.
errors.timeout: The site took too long to answer.
errors.tls_error: The site’s security certificate is not valid.
errors.http_error: The site refused, or could not provide, the page.
errors.not_html: This address is not a web page.
errors.robots_disallowed: The site asks robots not to read this page (robots.txt).
errors.redirect_loop: The site redirects in a loop.
errors.empty_site: No readable text: the site probably shows its content with JavaScript, which Postbiz does not run.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.

errors.filesLimit: You have reached the maximum of {max} documents.
errors.sitesLimit: You have reached the maximum of {max} websites.
errors.dailyLimit: Too many documents and websites added today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.duplicate: This website is already in your knowledge base.
errors.invalidUrl: This address is not valid, or the site is not public.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too big ({max} MB at most).
errors.unsupportedType: This file type is not supported (PDF, Word, text, Markdown, CSV or HTML).
